ui_bugs.issue: Legacy events created before Phase 2 have link_expires_at=null and originals_delete_at=null in Mongo. `new Date(null).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR')` renders as '01.01.1970' on the event card ('Link: 01.01.1970' / 'Orijinal silinme: 01.01.1970'). Newer events display the correct dates. Suggested fix: guard fmtDate to return '—' when iso is null/undefined. Non-blocking cosmetic issue only for pre-existing events.

rca of the issue: Legacy 01.01.1970 render: pre-Phase-2 gallery_events docs in Mongo lack link_expires_at / originals_delete_at fields. Backend _event_out passes the null through; StudioGallery.jsx's fmtDate does `new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR')` where `new Date(null)` yields the Unix epoch (1970-01-01). Fix: `const fmtDate = (iso) => { if (!iso) return '—'; try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR'); } catch { return '—'; } };`
